sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: Squad Ownership: Team Drives Delivery; Team Leads Value Creation. Squad Learning: Continuous Improvement; Collective Mastery. SM Ownership: Encouraging Team Ownership; Driving Team Success. Leader Learning: Supporting Team Learning; Enabling Organisational Growth. Leader Ownership: Enabling Team Autonomy.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: Squad behaviours may indicate that improvement is owned within the team, while SM and Leader behaviours suggest that improvement leadership and capability-building are supported across roles rather than concentrated in one role.
